title_en: Fall 2026 College of Engineering K-STAR Visa Track Nominations for Outstanding Talent
summary: Foreign researchers in science and technology fields who wish to change their status of stay to Outstanding Talent Residence (F-2-7S) may apply for nomination under the College of Engineering K-STAR Visa Track for Fall 2026. Applicants must complete the outstanding talent nomination documents ([Attachment 2]) and the nominee list ([Attachment 3]) and submit them by email by Thursday, 15 October 2026. The email address is given in the original notice; each department may nominate at most two people.
applies_to: Foreign outstanding talent in science and technology research fields who wish to change their status of stay to Outstanding Talent Residence (F-2-7S). Participation is voluntary (for those who wish to apply); each department may nominate at most two people.

dates.what: Deadline to submit the nomination documents and nominee list by email (department to College of Engineering)
Review and selection by the Outstanding Talent Recommendation Committee (College of Engineering)
Submission of the nominee list from the College of Engineering to the Office of International Affairs
Review by the International Steering Committee (Office of International Affairs)
Issuance of the President's letter of recommendation (Office of International Affairs)
Performance management and self-report (department to College of Engineering)

conditions: Only foreign researchers in science and technology research fields who wish to change to Outstanding Talent Residence (F-2-7S) status are eligible.
Each department may recommend a maximum of two people.
Both the outstanding talent nomination documents ([Attachment 2]) and the nominee list ([Attachment 3]) must be submitted.
Nominees are reviewed and selected by the Outstanding Talent Recommendation Committee and then by the International Steering Committee; submission does not guarantee a recommendation.
Standards for submitting an overseas criminal record certificate are given in a separate reference attachment, which was not read for this translation.
steps: Read the full guidance in the attachments ([Attachment 1-1] in Korean or [Attachment 1-2] in English) and the reference document on overseas criminal record certificate submission standards (해외범죄경력증명서 제출 기준); these attachments were not read for this translation.
Download the form package [Attachment 2] K-STAR Visa Track Outstanding Talent Nomination Document Forms (K-STAR 비자트랙 우수인재 추천서류 서식.zip) and complete the outstanding talent nomination documents.
Complete [Attachment 3] Outstanding Talent Nominee List (우수인재 추천자 명단); note that this file does not appear in the list of attachments, so ask the department office if you cannot find it.
Email the completed documents to the address given in the original notice by Thursday, 15 October 2026.
translation:
[Office of International Cooperation] Fall 2026 College of Engineering 「K-STAR Visa Track」 Call for Nominations of Outstanding Talent (until 10/15)

The College of Engineering is recruiting outstanding talent for the Fall 2026 「K-STAR Visa Track」 as follows. Please complete the required documents and submit them to [email address given in the original notice] by Thursday, 15 October 2026.

A. Eligible nominees: Foreign outstanding talent in science and technology research fields who wish to change their status of stay to 'Outstanding Talent Residence (F-2-7S)'.

B. Number of nominees: A maximum of 2 per department.

C. Documents to submit: [Attachment 2] Outstanding Talent Nomination Documents; [Attachment 3] Outstanding Talent Nominee List.

D. Main schedule (Item | Period | Note):
- K-STAR Visa Track outstanding talent recruitment | (no period stated) | College of Engineering / departments
- Submission of the K-STAR Visa Track nominee list | until Thursday, 15 October 2026 | department -> College of Engineering
- Review and selection by the Outstanding Talent Recommendation Committee | November 2026 | College of Engineering
- Submission of the K-STAR Visa Track nominee list | until Friday, 4 December 2026 | College of Engineering -> Office of International Affairs
- Review by the International Steering Committee | Tuesday, 22 December 2026 | Office of International Affairs
- Issuance of the President's letter of recommendation | January 2027 | Office of International Affairs
- Performance management and self-report | February 2027 | department -> College of Engineering

E. References:
- [Korean guidance link] Fall 2026 College of Engineering 「K-STAR Visa Track」 Call for Nominations of Outstanding Talent - Notices - Notices - Communication Plaza - Seoul National University College of Engineering
- [English guidance link] 2026 Fall Semester College of Engineering: Call for Nominations for the "K-STAR Visa Track" - Notice - Notice - Communication - College of Engineering

Attachments (5) (the contents of the attachments were not read for this translation):
- Fall 2026 College of Engineering 「K-STAR Visa Track」 Call for Nominations of Outstanding Talent.pdf (155 KB)
- [Attachment 1-1] Fall 2026 Seoul National University College of Engineering 「K-STAR Visa Track」 Call for Nominations of Outstanding Talent.hwpx (52 KB)
- [Attachment 1-2] 2026 Fall Semester College of Engineering Call for Nominations for the 「K-STAR Visa Track」.pdf (52 KB)
- [Attachment 2] K-STAR Visa Track Outstanding Talent Nomination Document Forms (K-STAR 비자트랙 우수인재 추천서류 서식).zip (173 KB)
- [Reference] Overseas Criminal Record Certificate Submission Standards, Korean and English (해외범죄경력증명서 제출 기준_국영문).pdf (220 KB)

Note: [Attachment 3] Outstanding Talent Nominee List is mentioned in the notice but does not appear in the attachment list.
